sentence: Tell me when someone opens the gate, with the picture.
name: Gate Open Alert
plan: Watch the gate for it swinging open
Send an alert as soon as it opens
Attach the picture that proved it
Record when it closes and for how long

sensors.question: Is the gate open, with its panel swung away from the closed position and a clear gap in the fence line where the gate normally blocks passage?
sensors.reason: A gate stays open at least a few seconds; checking every 1.2s catches even a brief opening, and 5s clear avoids splitting one opening when a person or car briefly hides it.
requires: A gate panel is visible swung away from its closed, fence-aligned position
An open gap is visible in the fence line where the closed gate normally blocks passage

writer_steps: A reviewer is checking the rule against your words
